paite: Gimlim halna ding maitam na bawl ding ahi. Singgi sing in na bawl ding ahi.
heading: Gimnamtui Halna Maitam / (Eks 37.25-28)

paite: Asau lam tong khat ahi dia; azatlam tong khat mah. Asau lam leh azatlam akikim dia, asanlam tong nih ahi ding ahi. Akiite leng akibang in sa khat ahi ding uhi
Dangka-engtak in na luan dia; atung, asikte leh akiite ah akimvel in dangka-eng in agei vel na bawl ding hi.
Dangka-eng sikkual nih apang nih a ding na bawl dia, maitam pang nihte ah na bulh dia, azawnna zawlte khumna ding ahi ding uhi.
Singgi sing in azawnna ding chiangte na bawl dia, dangka-eng in huaite na luan ding ahi.
K'on kituahpihna ding mun, theihsakna tung a om zahngaihna tutphah ma, theihpihna bawm kiang a om puanzak ma ah na koih ding ahi.
Zingsang teng in huai tung ahbAaron in gimlim ahal dia; khawnvakte adet chiang in, atung ah gimlim ahal ding ahi.
Nitaklam a Aaron in khawnvakte adet chiang in, atung ah gimlim ahal ding hi. Na khang na khang un TOUPA ma a gimlim ahi tawntung ding hi.
Huai ah theih louh gimlim hiam halmang thillat hiam, tangbuang thillat hiam, na lan ding uh ahi kei. Huai lou in huai ah dawn thillat leng na sung ding uh ahi kei hi.
Kum khat in khatvei Aaron in khelhna thillat sisan akiite ah atat dia, lemna abawl ding ahi. Na khang na khang un kum khat in khatvei atung ah lemna abawl ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia siangthoupen ahi.
Huai khit in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Siah

paite: "Azah uh theihna dia kisimpina na bawl chiang in, pasal chih in ahinna tatna sum TOUPA kiang a apiak ding ahi. Hiai ahihleh amaute na sim chiang a alak ua hipi alenlouhna ding ahi.
Simtel a om michih in tatna sum apiak ding ahi. Mun siangthou sum shekel kimkhat ahi ding ahi. Shekel khat gerah sawmnih a gik ahi.
Simtel a omte lak a paisuak peuhmah kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam in TOUPA kiang a thillat alat ding uh ahi.
Na kha ua ding a lemna bawlna dia, TOUPA kiang a thillat apiak chiang un, ahaute leh azawngte'n shekel kimkhat sang a tamzaw leh tawmzaw apiak louh ding uh ahi.
Hiai bang in Israel suante lemna sum na la dia, kihoupihna biakbuk a nasepna ding in na sep ding ahi; na kha uh tatna ding a, TOUPA ma a Israel suante a dia theihgigena ahihtheihna ding in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
heading: Dal Tuikuang

paite: "Kisilna ding in tuikuang dal in na bawl dia, atunna khete leng dal in na bawl ding ahi. Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam kikal ah na koih dia, huai ah tui na koih ding ahi.
Aaron leh atapate'n akhutte uh leh akhete uh tui in asil ding uh ahi.
Kihoupihna puanin sung a alut ding chiang uhiam, nasem dia TOUPA mai a, mei a thillat lan dia maitam anaih ding chiang ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Akisil kei uleh asi ding uhi.

Huai bang a, asihlouhna ding ua akhutte uh leh akhete uh asil ding uh ahi. Hiai tangtawn in amau a ding in dan thuseh ahi dia; akhang-akhang un amah a ding leh asuante a ding nangawn in ahi ding ahi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen lai hi:
heading: Thaunilhna Sathau

paite: "Gimlim leng kilak inla, murrah tui shekel zanga leh singguithak gimlim huai zah kimkhat, shekel zanih-le-sawmnga sialluang khum shekel zanih-le-sawmnga,
Singguithak shekel zanga, mun siangthou shekel dungzui in, olive thau hin khat.
Nilh theih siangthou in thau na bawl dia, nilh theih damdawi misiamna bang a gawm; nilh theih thau siangthou ahi ding.
Huai in kihoupihna biakbuk na nuh ding, theihpihna bawm toh,
adohkan leh abelsuan tengteng leh khawnvak koihna leh abelsuan chiteng leh gimlim maitam toh.
Haltum thillat maitam leh abelsuan tengteng leh tuikuang leh akhe.
Huaite asiangthoupen hi ding in na hihsiangthou ding ahi. Bangpeuh huaite khoih asianthou ngeingei ding uh ahi.
Aaron leh atapate thau na nilh dia, amau na siangsak ding, siampu nasepna mun a kei a dia nna aseptheihna ding un.
Israel suante kiang ah thu na gen dia, na khang na khang un kei a ding in hiai thaunilh siangthou ahi ding hi.
Mihing sa tung ah na buak ding uh ahi kei. Akihelkhawm bang in akibatpih dang himhim leng na bawl ding uh ahi kei. Hiai nilh siangthou ahi a, nou a ding in asiangthou ding ahi.
Hiai bangbang a hel a, akibatpih sathau bawl hiam, siampu hilou midang tung a zang hiam kuapeuh amite lak a pan ka satkhe ding, achi," chi in.
Huai ban ah TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Gimlimte, singnai, onicha, galbanum leh begaw akikim chiat la in.
heading: Gimnamtui

paite: Hiaite a pan gimnamtui na bawl ding ahi. Gimnamtui bawlsiamte hel bang na hel ding ahi. Chisoh, asiang leh azek a siangthou ahi ding hi.
Khenkhat na gawizan mahmah dia, kihoupihna biakbuk sung a theihpihna ma ah na koih dia, huai ah ka hon kimuhpih ding hi. Hiai nang a ding in siangthoupen ahi ding hi.
Na bawl ding gimnamtui toh kisai in, ahelkhawmdan a abatpih nou aituam ding in na kibawl ding ahi kei. Nou a ding in TOUPA mai ah siangthou ahi ding ahi.
Agim namtui nap dia abatpih bawl peuhmah amite a pan ka satkhe ding," achi hi.
